content: The test image shows coffee leaves with circular lesions featuring dark brown/black centers and lighter halos — a classic "eye spot" pattern. This strongly suggests Brown_Eye_Spot or Cercospora. Let me view one reference to confirm.

This pattern (circular lesions with dark center + lighter halo on coffee leaves) is the defining feature of **Brown_Eye_Spot** (Cercospora coffeicola), which affects both leaves and berries.
